desc: Elevate your lever action rimfire to the next level with this purpose-built MDT stock, engineered for modern performance without sacrificing the classic feel of a smooth-cycling lever action. Featuring a simple takedown design for quick and easy field maintenance, the stock is built around a rigid one-piece Picatinny rail for seamless optics mounting and an 18" medium profile threaded barrel ready for your favorite muzzle device or suppressor. Adjustable iron sights with a hooded front sight provide fast, reliable target acquisition right out of the box. Up front, heavy grip touchpoints and M-LOK slots on the forend offer endless accessory mounting options. An interchangeable comb height allow the stock to fit a wide range of shooters and optic heights, making this the ultimate upgrade for any tactical rimfire build.
